messages.subject: Question regarding tiling
messages.body_plain:
Hello,
Thanks for the great tool. I have a quick question regarding the validity check for tileMethylCounts function. For this particular experiment I have 9 samples (5 called MORs and 3 called FORS). Now, when I am performing DMR analysis, while I am doing tiling, I am getting the following warning "object has more than one sample id: only one allowed". While reading the data I am reading it based on the default resolution, i.e. base, and filtering it based on criteria defined in the tutorial. I could not attach the code and the output, let me know where I can send those, for your perusal. I have 2 questions in this case:
a) Should I ignore this warning?
b) If not is there a special way to handle DMRs?

Please let me know if you have any further questions.

Thanks,
Surajit

messages.subject: Question regarding tiling in DMR
messages.body_plain:
Hello,
Thanks for the great tool. I have a quick question regarding the validity check for tileMethylCounts function. For this particular experiment I have 9 samples (5 called MORs and 3 called FORS). Now, when I am performing DMR analysis, while I am doing tiling, I am getting the following warning "object has more than one sample id: only one allowed". While reading the data I am reading it based on the default resolution, i.e. base, and filtering it based on criteria defined in the tutorial. Please find attached the code and the output till the filtering. I have 2 questions in this case:
a) Should I ignore this warning?
b) If not is there a special way to handle DMRs?

Please let me know if you have any further questions.

Thanks,
Surajit

With Regards,
Surajit Bhattacharya

Research Postdoctoral Fellow

Eric Vilain Lab

Genetic Medicine

Children’s National Medical Center

messages.subject: Re: bismak_methylation_extractor files into methylkit
messages.body_plain:
Hello Karan,

You can use readBismarkCytosineReport function to import bismark generated report which is generally have following information

#Chr                #pos         #strand      #mCs         #Ts             #context     #bases
Chr01        67      +       0       1       CG      CGA
Chr01        68      -       0       0       CHH     CGT
Chr01        192     +       1       0       CHG     CGT
Chr01        193     -       2       7       CG      CGA
Chr01        239     +       0       1       CHG     CGA
Chr01        240     -       1       7       CG      CGT
Chr01        339     +       0       0       CHH     CGA

Hope you get the answer.

Best,
Abdul Rawoof

messages.subject: tileMethylcounts not using defined cores.
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I am using methylkit version 1.12.0.

The tileMethylCounts function is not utilizing provided cores.

When I am performing analysing methylation sites in a given tiling window as follows:

tiles_meth=tileMethylCounts(myobj,win.size=100,step.size=50,cov.bases=3, mc.cores = 15)

Though I have mentioned mc.core=15, but still it is using only single thread of a core.

Please could you help me out how can I use multiple cores for this analysis.

Thanks,

Best,
Altuna
